Qqpahan pnwalang ka Nigeria pusu balay qqpahan sntuku pila wayhuy cbiyaw. Nigeria cbiyaw pa mnqnlangan knbeyhing bay qnlhangan cuko trabus, koko mi abura qhuni sksik, kiya mi qhuni beyhing sbiki, mmudu hiyi pnwalang, lhngay, yuku, bunga qhuni, sanyaw mi sibus pusu balay pnyahan qnlhangan.
